verdict.rationale: Vendor docs describe Copilot chat, agent creation, and natural-language interaction with agents/slash commands inside Teams (ms-teams-docs-1, -6, -9, -15, -28, -31), indicating some agentic/NL capability exists. However, this is largely vendor-only documentation about building/using agents rather than evidence of robust, user-facing natural-language control of core Teams functions, and no independent community evidence validates real-world reliability of this capability.
